purpose: Separate native RNG/timing/owner semantics from explicitly stable Cells perturbations and reproducible component replay
source_scope: Authenticated AST statements/guards and full update_Co/div_env/no_negs/single_cell/disabled MT methods; actual NumPy RNG delegated through recording proxy; phase labels and unrelated event hooks normalized

units.static_K: Dm m2/s times dimensionless uniform multiplier, positive-biased when level>0
units.protein: Uniform membrane flux mol/(m2*s), concentration mol/m3, amount mol, dt seconds
units.microtubule: Disabled source numeric scale mixes vector norm with kBT and length2 under sqrt, then adds it to radians; no physical Brownian claim

timing.static: Always consumes M uniforms, even level zero; Dm_base copied before noise, SIM fire_events subsequently resets Dm_cells=base+scheduled
timing.protein: Normal SIM and enabled P/dynamic==1 only; one M-vector per loop call including t=0, independent of sample times; no sqrt(dt) rescaling
timing.boundary: One choice at callback construction, constant dynamics; duplicate boundary occurrences carry weights
timing.microtubule: Import/config/init/update integration commented out; explicit isolated diagnostic only, draw only if dilation>0

rng_laws.native: NumPy legacy MT19937 complete 624-word state/position/has_gauss/cached_gaussian and NumPy version; local replay preserves source sequential call/owner order; no global RNG mutation
rng_laws.cells: Separate Threefry2x32 seed/world64/tick64/site/SHA256-owner fold-in, open52 pairs and Box-Muller; order/subset isolation is a Cells convention, not native RNG equivalence

owners: Explicit stable cell/membrane/environment axes and occurrence sequences; no geometry generation/remap

conservation.matrix: Full area-weighted cell/environment flux cancels; no concentration clipping in accepted component
conservation.fast: Native last-duplicate scatter multiplied by summed areas can break conservation; source_fast arithmetic retained and conservative predicate rejects observed defect
conservation.bath: Native mean-mixed bath matches effective volume M*vol_env, not vol_env; heterogeneous initial vector collapse unsupported
conservation.bulk: Later source update_all_concs/no_negs can clip negative cells and leave negative/stale membrane values; preserved as unsupported

statistics.moment_bounds: Six standard errors under analytic uniform/normal moments
statistics.protein: Independent Decimal owner arithmetic; analytic area covariance and per-world amount budgets; fixed elapsed-time variance proportional to dt at fixed flux amplitude

replay: Hash-validated active component buffers, controls, logical tick/clock, explicit RNG law/state; disabled MT/source draw packets replay separately with prescribed inputs; no shared simulator checkpoint migration
scope_limits: No whole-tissue physiology, evolving geometry, cut or activation of disabled MT paths
No physical Brownian, thermodynamic noise or energy/ATP model claim
Native sequential stream and Cells identity stream are distinct laws
Callers own other RNG sites, source solver order, positivity/domain acceptance and downstream physical coupling
